name: Poet Fenella

intro.text: Larkin said Hull was on the edge of the world. I've come to the edge to battle. Please be gentle, I'm sensitive.

win: A rhyme: you won, I'm done. Not my best.
after: Larkin wrote at night, in a flat overlooking Pearson Park, and kept his diaries in a drawer. He asked for them to be burnt, and they were.
